description: This file defines a string-to-pointer map data structure with associated operations, including string map, string integer map, and string set implementations. It declares structures, macros, and functions for managing string-based collections and their memory management.

methods.name: cmp_strmap_entry
methods.description: Comparison function for strmap entries, used for ordering and equality checks.

methods.name: strmap_init
methods.description: Initializes a strmap, allocating resources and setting default parameters.

methods.name: strmap_init_with_options
methods.description: Initializes a strmap with custom memory pool and string duplication options.

methods.name: strmap_clear
methods.description: Clears all entries from a strmap, freeing associated resources if specified.

methods.name: strmap_partial_clear
methods.description: Clears the map but preserves table capacity for efficient reuse.

methods.name: strmap_put
methods.description: Inserts or updates an entry in the map with a string key and data pointer.

methods.name: strmap_get_entry
methods.description: Retrieves the internal entry for a given string key, if it exists.

methods.name: strmap_get
methods.description: Returns the data pointer associated with a string key.

methods.name: strmap_contains
methods.description: Checks if a string key exists in the map.

methods.name: strmap_remove
methods.description: Removes a string key from the map, freeing value if requested.

methods.name: unsigned int strmap_get_size(struct strmap * map)
methods.description: Returns the number of entries in the map.

methods.name: int strmap_empty(struct strmap * map)
methods.description: Returns whether the map is empty.

methods.name: strmap_for_each_entry
methods.description: Macro for iterating over each entry in the strmap.

methods.name: void strintmap_init(struct strintmap * map,int default_value)
methods.description: Initializes a string-to-int map with a default value.

methods.name: void strintmap_init_with_options(struct strintmap * map,int default_value,struct mem_pool * pool,int strdup_strings)
methods.description: Initializes a strintmap with memory options and default value.

methods.name: void strintmap_clear(struct strintmap * map)
methods.description: Clears a strintmap, freeing resources.

methods.name: void strintmap_partial_clear(struct strintmap * map)
methods.description: Partially clears the strintmap, preserving capacity.

methods.name: int strintmap_contains(struct strintmap * map,const char * str)
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the strintmap.

methods.name: void strintmap_remove(struct strintmap * map,const char * str)
methods.description: Removes a key from the strintmap.

methods.name: int strintmap_empty(struct strintmap * map)
methods.description: Checks if strintmap is empty.

methods.name: unsigned int strintmap_get_size(struct strintmap * map)
methods.description: Returns the number of entries in the strintmap.

methods.name: int strintmap_get(struct strintmap * map,const char * str)
methods.description: Retrieves the integer value associated with a string key.

methods.name: void strintmap_set(struct strintmap * map,const char * str,intptr_t v)
methods.description: Sets the integer value for a given string key.

methods.name: strintmap_incr
methods.description: Increments the integer value for a key, adding it if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: void strset_init(struct strset * set)
methods.description: Initializes a string set.

methods.name: void strset_init_with_options(struct strset * set,struct mem_pool * pool,int strdup_strings)
methods.description: Initializes a string set with memory options.

methods.name: void strset_clear(struct strset * set)
methods.description: Clears all entries in the string set.

methods.name: void strset_partial_clear(struct strset * set)
methods.description: Partially clears the string set for reuse.

methods.name: int strset_contains(struct strset * set,const char * str)
methods.description: Checks whether a string is present in the set.

methods.name: void strset_remove(struct strset * set,const char * str)
methods.description: Removes a string from the set.

methods.name: int strset_empty(struct strset * set)
methods.description: Checks whether the set is empty.

methods.name: unsigned int strset_get_size(struct strset * set)
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the set.

methods.name: strset_add
methods.description: Adds a string to the set.
